stories.title: Woman, dog killed after being hit by car in Phoenix
stories.summary: According to Phoenix PD, the woman and her dog were walking outside of the crosswalk when they were hit.

stories.title: Arrest made following deadly assault at care facility in Phoenix
stories.summary: A 60-year-old man assaulted at a care facility in Phoenix later died from his injuries. Police have recently made an arrest.

stories.title: 87-year-old pedestrian dies after being struck by vehicle in north Phoenix
stories.summary: Police say the man was crossing Beardsley Road in an area under construction when he was hit; impairment is not believed to be a factor.

stories.title: Mattel Adventure Park at VAI Resort in Glendale is now 'Mattel City'
stories.summary: The VAI Resort in Glendale expands with the creation of Mattel City, including themed hotels and attractions, promising a unique entertainment destination for all.

stories.title: Enjoy another round of sunshine and above normal temps today, changes roll through Tuesday
stories.summary: Rain and thunderstorms developing tomorrow morning across Arizona

stories.title: Longtime downtown Phoenix radio station demolished to make room for unprecedented hotel
stories.summary: Atari Hotel is expected to open between late 2028 to early 2029.

stories.title: Phoenix Homebuyers: Up to $17,500 in Down Payment Help
stories.summary: A local buyer used grants and seller concessions to purchase a home. A lender shares how to ask about assistance.

stories.title: Federal Report: Dragon Bravo Fire Supervisor was not qualified to lead effort
stories.summary: Lack of training and ignored warning signs are included in the Department of Interior's 65-page "Significant Wildfire Review" of the 2025 Dragon Bravo Fire.

stories.title: 3 students from Salpointe Catholic High School killed in fiery crash in Pima County
stories.summary: Three teens died in a fiery crash in Pima County when speed and impairment led the vehicle off the road, officials said.

stories.title: 'We're just stuck': Travelers stranded in Phoenix days after nationwide ground stop
stories.summary: Hundreds of delays and cancelations were reported at Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport over the weekend.

stories.title: 3 in critical condition after a 2-car crash in north Phoenix
stories.summary: The crash happened near Sweetwater Avenue and 32nd Street.

stories.title: Fallout from Friday's FAA ground stop continues at Phoenix Sky Harbor
stories.summary: As of 2 p.m. on Nov. 14, over 80 flights have been cancelled and over 200 flights have been delayed.
